New episodes of 9to5Mac Daily are recorded every weekday. Subscribe to our podcast on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast player to make sure you catch every new episode as soon as it goes live.

Stories discussed in this episode:

  • watchOS 27.2 beta 2 brings back the App Switcher with a brand-new gesture
  • Report says Apple is developing a Whoop-like screenless fitness tracker
  • What exactly is going on with GM's CarPlay strategy (or lack thereof)?
  • Apple discontinues the unique augmented reality experience at the Apple Park Visitor Center
